QUOTE: The pre-commit `gen-bindings --check` fails on drift.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says generated bindings are guarded by a pre-commit `gen-bindings --check` that fails on drift. It never says the check re-runs the generator and diffs. Still, "--check" on a generator hook in pre-commit conveys the same mechanism, so I count the item as stated.
